title: Folio 7: The Secret Order Against the Loyal General | The Honest Historian – Stories from Beyhaqi
description:
His sultan signed a secret order to have him killed. The plot failed, and old Altuntash, governor of Khwarazm, had every reason to rebel. Instead he marched to war for the man who had tried to murder him. Beyhaqi's story of loyalty, a whispering courtier, and a death near Bukhara.

Source: Tarikh-e Beyhaqi, volume seven: the sections on Bu Sahl's intrigue against Altuntash, the killing of Qaid Malanjuq, Amir Masud's letter to Altuntash, the planning of the war with Ali Tegin, and the choice of Khwaja Ahmad Abd al-Samad as vizier (423 AH / 1032 CE); volume nine for the vizier's remark; background from Encyclopaedia Iranica and Wikipedia ('Altuntash (khwarazmshah)', 'Abu Sahl Zawzani', 'Ahmad Shirazi').
Retold in English from the Persian original by Mehdi Rahmani and narrated with an AI rendering of his own voice.
